## How it works

<h3>Measure site access</h3><ol><li>Find a street or approach beside the stadium and zoom to its edges.</li><li>On the left toolbar, open Measure (ruler) → Add measurement. Set Measure Mode to Length and pick two survey points to measure a route or its width.</li><li>Measure a second route to compare the available space.</li></ol>
<h3>Inspect a scan section</h3><ol><li>Find the stadium edge and its surrounding ground.</li><li>On the left toolbar, open Sections (scissors) → Add clipping plane, then click a surface to cut through the scan and examine ground and elevated features.</li><li>Drag the section to compare nearby buildings and vegetation.</li></ol>
<h3>Developer integration</h3><p>Load the original classified LAZ survey once with <code>viewer.add()</code>. The SDK provides point picking, measurement and section controls for the same scan. Source classification is preserved. The survey was captured in 2010 and classified by Max Sampson, Hobu, Inc. in 2021; these exercises do not represent a current site access assessment.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
